title: cutover(ui-merge): wind down the objectui repository — close its 6 bot PRs, transfer the open cards to objectstack, close the seat posts, migration-notice README, delete the 381 `claude/*` branches; the maintainer archives (parent #25752 steps 7–8)
body:
Ruled: 6408546832 · letter A · 2026-10-26T05:00Z

Filing gate ③ + ④: steps 7 and 8 of the cutover procedure #25752 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25752. Part of #25677. Blocked-by: none — all four cutover PRs are on `main` (#25825, #25745, #25827, #25834, merged 2026-10-25 22:51Z – 10-26 00:24Z). ⛔ Not a claim: the coordinator opens the card thread. The archive click itself is the maintainer's.

**Maintainer's words** (D1 ruling, project thread 2026-10-24 01:32Z, verbatim): 「这个如果影响我们的开发效率的话，是否可以吧 objectui 仓库改为 一个迁移说明？」 — the objectui repository becomes a migration notice and is archived.

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** until objectui is archived, two boards exist for one code base: 69 open issues sit in a repository whose `main` is frozen, Dependabot keeps opening PRs against a tree nobody will merge, and a contributor landing on github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui finds no pointer to `ui/`. Every day of that is a day the fleet reads the wrong board.

## Measured (2026-10-26 00:27Z)

- **Open PRs: 6, all bots, no human branch to port.** #13547 `chore: release packages` (changeset-release/main — obsolete: releases now come from the root lane, 4a #25745); Dependabot #13434, #13435, #13437, #13438, #13439. Nothing meets step 7's `git format-patch | git am --directory=ui` clause.
- **Open issues: 69.** By label: `pm:queue` ≈ 49, `pm:blocked` 3 (#13546, #13543, #13447), `pm:on-hold` 2 (#10971, #3592), `needs-user-decision` 1 (#13539), `tracking` 4 (#12444, #7233, #4806, #2763), `pm:seat` 7 (#5560, #5748, #9800, #9771, #10243, #10488, #11311). Two carry assignees (#10488 os-tesla, #9771 baozhoutao, #5748 os-warren — seat posts).
- **Remote branches: 1263**: `claude/*` 381 (none with an open PR), `dependabot/*` 6, `changeset-release/main` 1, the rest (`copilot/*`, `chore/*`, …) are history and stay with the archive.

## Wanted (in this order; every GitHub write through the fleet relay, paced — `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --status` before each batch, `--announce-batch N` for ≥ 5)

1. **PRs.** Close #13547 (release lane retired by #25745; the pending `ui/.changeset/*` ride #25831) and the 5 Dependabot PRs (one comment each, distinct text, naming where Dependabot now runs: the root `.github/dependabot.yml` after #25712's workflow port). ⛔ Never the same comment text on many items.
2. **Cards → objectstack.** `node scripts/pm/issue-transfer.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectui --issue <n> --to objectstack-ai/objectstack` one card per call for every open issue that is work (`pm:queue` / `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` / `needs-user-decision` / `tracking` except #7233). Transfer keeps comments and redirects the old number. After each transfer: labels mapped — `domain:ui` stays (the lane folds into objectstack per #25712's AGENTS.md rewrite), `repo:*` none needed, `area:*` kept; paths quoted in bodies now live under `ui/` — one audit comment per card saying so (⛔ do not rewrite bodies). Re-read #25752's audit comments for cards already transferred before you start.
3. **Seat posts and handover.** Close the 7 `pm:seat` posts and #7233 as `not_planned` with one closing comment each pointing at the objectstack `domain:ui` seat post (open one in objectstack if none exists — epic PM confirms the number on this card first). Unassign os-tesla / baozhoutao / os-warren from them in the same stroke.
4. **README.** One objectui PR: the first section of `README.md` becomes the migration notice — where the code lives now (`objectstack-ai/objectstack` `ui/`, with `git subtree add` at `9e1fe03286` and history kept), how to port a branch (`git format-patch origin/main..<branch> --stdout | git am --directory=ui`), where the issues went (transferred, old numbers redirect), that `@object-ui/*` packages continue from the root release lane at one version with `@objectstack/*`, and that the repository is archived. Draft the notice text on this card first; the epic PM reads it before the PR. This is the last PR to merge into objectui `main` (frozen since 2026-10-25 15:40Z — the freeze lifts for this one PR only, maintainer merges).
5. **Branches.** Delete the 381 `claude/*` branches (relay `branch_delete` if the op exists, else list them on this card and the maintainer deletes in bulk). Leave `main`, `changeset-release/main`, `dependabot/*` and the historical branches.
6. **Archive (maintainer).** Report on this card and on #25752: PRs 0 open, issues 0 open (or the list of what deliberately stays), README merged. The maintainer archives the repository (Settings → Danger Zone → Archive). After the click: the Vercel docs project and the npm scope need nothing (decision A; docs-site deploy is #25753's).

## Acceptance

- objectui: 0 open PRs, 0 open issues except what this card lists as deliberately kept, README head = migration notice, `claude/*` branches gone, repository archived by the maintainer.
- objectstack: every transferred card carries its audit comment; the `domain:ui` seat post exists; #25752 carries the step 7–8 closing comment.

**Size:** L (mechanical, write-paced). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## 风险

- Throttle: ~70 transfers + ~15 closures + 381 branch deletes is the biggest single-day write batch this fleet has done; pace per `write-pace.mjs` and stop on the first exit 10. Prefer two or three sittings over one burst.
- A transferred card's `Claim:` lines and `pm:dispatched` labels from objectui seats are stale; strip `pm:dispatched` where no live seat holds it (Tesla's 2-hour rule applies).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26 00:29Z 「objectui migration transfer open issues cards to objectstack archive objectui repository README migration notice close branches」: 8 hits, all the epic family (#25677, #25752, #25712, #25753, #25831, #25832, #25556, #25715); the procedure lives in #25752 steps 7–8 and no card carries them. **New.**
